categories.name: build
categories.evidence: Carries the 'Build system' label and updates CMake compiler checks, CI workflow environments, and clang-format configuration to bump minimum Clang support to version 19.
categories.rationale: Bumping the minimum Clang version to 19 enables modern C++20 features like CTAD on alias templates and allows dropping workarounds for older compiler bugs. While beneficial for contributor tooling and future code cleanup, the bump is not driven by an urgent upstream deadline or platform breakage.

categories.name: docs
categories.evidence: Changes to doc/dependencies.md and release notes directly follow the build configuration change and do not constitute a standalone documentation change.
categories.rationale: Not a member because documentation updates merely reflect the compiler minimum version bump.
